rule_reading: Literal FIX_LOOP step 4: position error and bias improve on the held-out game and arena; team labels (a pass/fail row) dip on both CLE games, within noise on cle_gsw and borderline on cle_nyk; cle_gsw coverage is below the 50% floor for V3 and r23 alike (r23 raises it).
